text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. These help everyone understand exactly what needs to be done. It is also important to define milestones—key points in the project timeline—and deliverables, which are the final products or results. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because all involved parties, such as team members, managers, and clients, should agree on the goals and expectations. When everyone shares the same vision and understands their responsibilities, the project is much more likely to stay on track and achieve the desired results.
